spBindings.sourceEvent: AbilityStandard.OnSpellStart: if damage/heal output succeeds (or allowNoTarget) and spellCnt==0 -> OnOutputAttackOrHeal; Entity forwards to SpController; INCREASE_WHEN_ATTACK increments once; EnemySkill registration contributes SP_RECOVER_STOPPED.

selector.orderingBoundary: Use shared hatred ordering without a blocker preference; equal-hatred tie order is an explicit implementation convention.

projectile.castEndBehavior: Released projectiles survive ordinary cast end: RangedAttack.OnCastEnd clears only if waitForProjectileInvalid is true and notClearProjectileWhenCastEnd is false; this source wait flag is false.
projectile.payloadBuffs: active buffs belong to projectile action controller and attach on hit, not at animation release
projectile.arrivalRevalidation: Keep original target; do not reselect by tag/range after emission. Removed/dead target guard is the shared entity-lifecycle convention.
projectile.timeoutBehavior: If life expires with a still-valid original trace target, resolve one hit on that target; never substitute another target.
projectile.damageBuffOrdering: Apply source damage and source active Buff on the same projectile hit. Exact internal damage-versus-buff suborder is not fully recovered; runtime uses damage then Buff after the same dodge decision.

sourceOutputEvent.at: successful first spell output; after pre-delay yield; before projectile arrival
sourceOutputEvent.engineBridge: performEnemyBasicHit at first source OnAttack event creates projectiles then calls attackRecovery once. The waitForAttackEvent-to-native event-listener bridge remains Inferred.

runtimeContract.scope: Complete IronSandStorm skill and reusable tagged ranged + loaded hit Buff + attack-SP contract. No completion claim for all Jakill phases, talents or ArmorPiercing.

verified.claim: SP comes from explicit DB INCREASE_WHEN_ATTACK / init0 / max3 / increment1, not a guessed periodic every-third-basic counter.
OnSpellStart only calls the once-per-cast OnOutputAttackOrHeal when spellCnt==0 and output succeeds (allowNoTarget is false here); EachSpell is a separate hook.
Entity forwards OnOutputAttackOrHeal to SpController; its attack-type gate and increment invoke non-forced recovery, which honors SP_RECOVER_STOPPED.
EnemySkill registration contributes SP_RECOVER_STOPPED when recoverSpWhenAffecting is false. Default base getter returns false; normal skill output does not refill its own SP.
CircleRange _scaleble0 sets its radius to options.radius when nonnegative. Real collider2.25 is replaced by current owner mode radius2; no invented half-tile radius is added.
loadFromDB stun uses actual DB abnormalFlag0, isDamageMissable=true, durationKey stun, statusResistable AUTOMATIC. AUTOMATIC checks source static list[0,16,43,41], which contains STUNNED0.

Complete projectile GO contains SimpleProjectile, AdvancedMovement and EffectBehaviour with speed10/life10/maxHit1. ActionController attaches Buffs at OnHitTarget. Cast end does not clear this waitForProjectileInvalid=false projectile.

inferred: Native pre-delay yield precedes OnSpellStart; using the source OnAttack1.4667 event as the engine output point reuses the existing animation-listener bridge.
Exact equal-hatred tie ordering, collision geometry against target bodies, projectile timeout terminal behavior and removed-entity handling use explicit shared runtime conventions.
stun expiry is merged with max(existing expiry,new expiry). Source overrideType DEFAULT and maxStack1 are frozen, but the full override-group time merge implementation is not recovered.
Damage and loaded hit Buff occur on the same projectile collision; exact suborder and missability coupling follow the shared runtime bridge. No unreadable method is cited as proof.
Native formula supports playback updates; current compiler/runtime snapshots effective owner attack interval at cast start.
